message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build toolchain

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      all-platforms:
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-toolchain:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        platform: ${{ (inputs.all-platforms && fromJSON('["ubuntu-24.04", "macos-latest", "windows-latest]")) || fromJSON('["ubuntu-24.04"]') }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.platform }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out lingua-franca repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          submodules: recursive
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Prepare build environment
        uses: ./.github/actions/prepare-build-env
      - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.gradle/caches
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}
      - name: Build and package lf cli tools (regular build)
        run: ./gradlew build testCodeCoverageReport
        shell: bash
      - name: Report to CodeCov
        uses: ./.github/actions/report-code-coverage
        with:
          files: core/build/reports/jacoco/testCodeCoverageReport/testCodeCoverageReport.xml,cli/base/build/reports/jacoco/testCodeCoverageReport/testCodeCoverageReport.xml,cli/lfc/build/reports/jacoco/testCodeCoverageReport/testCodeCoverageReport.xml,cli/lfd/build/reports/jacoco/testCodeCoverageReport/testCodeCoverageReport.xml,cli/lff/build/reports/jacoco/testCodeCoverageReport/testCodeCoverageReport.xml",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs a Gradle build (`./gradlew build testCodeCoverageReport`) across a matrix of platforms. Evidence pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (experiment batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200) shows adding a Gradle dependency cache step before the build reduced median elapsed time by ~20.4% while preserving all build/test steps and conclusions. The repository contains build.gradle files, confirming repeated dependency fetching is applicable. The change inserts a single `actions/cache@v4` step keyed on OS plus Gradle files, before the existing build step, so coverage and required checks are unchanged and no new privileged actions, secrets, or deployment operations are introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
